rows.col_1: POST https://developer.api.autodesk.com/hq/v1/accounts/:account_id/companies/import
POST https://developer.api.autodesk.com/hq/v1/regions/eu/accounts/:account_id/companies/import
app only
account:write
JSON
Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is obtained via a two-legged OAuth flow.
Must be application/json.

Specifies the region where the service is located.                                                                                                        Possible values: US, EMEA. For the full list of supported regions, see the Regions page.
The account/hub ID of the company. This corresponds to the hub ID used in the Data Management API, with the “b." prefix removed. For example, b.c8b0c73d-3ae9 becomes c8b0c73d-3ae9.

Company name should be unique under an account/hub

Max length: 255

Trade type based on specialization

Refer to the trade list in the Parameters guide.

Company address line 1

Max length: 255

Company address line 2

Max length: 255

City in which company is located

Max length: 255

State or province in which company is located

Max length: 255

Note that the state_or_province value depends on the selected country value;
see the valid values in the state_or_province list in
the Parameters guide.

Postal code for the company location

Max length: 255

Country for this company

Refer to the country list in the Parameters guide.

Business phone number for the company

Max length: 255

Company website

Max length: 255

Short description or overview for company

Max length: 255
Used to associate a company in BIM 360 with the company data in an ERP system
